title: Ginza, der Schatz der Mandaer (German)
author: Mark Lidzbarski (trans)
description: Mark Lidzbarski's German translation of the Ginza, a central collection of Mandaean religious writings. Its cosmological and devotional material introduces the world of light, the soul's journey and the teachings of this living tradition.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/ginza.-der-schatz-der-mandaer).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
